E) TURKISH NAVY AND AIRFORCE WILL MAKE A WITHOUT FIRING EXERCISE
WITHIN ATHINAI FIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:
1.-EXERCISE AREA (WITHOUT FIRING): 390358N 0251230E -
385300N 0261000E - 384310N 0261435E - 384232N 0261409E - 
384313N 0252138E - 384521N 0252132E - 384521N 0250244E - 
390358N 0251230E.
AWYS G8 AND N604 (SOSIR-ATSOV), H59 AND Y94 (BIFOK-MARIK), 
N130 (ETRUD-PIVOS) AFFECTED.
2.-PROCEDURES FOR EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
2.1.-EXERCISE AIRCRAFT SHALL FLY VFR AND SHALL DISPLAY NAVIGATION
AND ANTI-COLLISION LIGHTS CONTINUOUSLY.
2.2.-EXERCISE AIRCRAFT SHALL NOT AFFECT HELLENIC NATIONAL AIRSPACE
LESS THAN 10NM ACCORDING TO AIP-GREECE, ENR 1.1-1, PARA 1.1.1.2.1.
2.3.-EXERCISE AIRCRAFT SHALL SUBMIT FLIGHT PLANS ACCORDING TO
AIP-GREECE, ENR 1.10 AND GEN 1.7-1.
